title: How Volcanoes Erupt — Educational Explainer
hero_prompt: Cinematic photoreal volcano with glowing magma chamber visible through rock, science visualization, soft atmospheric haze, 16:9 one camera angle

defaults.avatar_negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, on-screen text, burned-in text, watermark, logo, typography, letters, words, readable signage, UI overlay, lower third, chyron, title card

style_bible: Cinematic science documentary, photoreal natural environments, clear focal subject, one camera angle, soft 35mm grain, warm saturated full color, 16:9, plain unmarked surfaces, matte unprinted props, natural daylight

narration.style_prompt:
AUDIO PROFILE: Engaging science documentary host.

DIRECTOR'S NOTES:
- Clear, curious, accessible to general audience.
- Keep lines under nineteen seconds.
- End with a question when handing off to a character beat.

scene_lines.01_hook: [curious] Beneath every quiet mountain, molten rock waits under immense pressure. What finally breaks the surface?
scene_lines.03_mechanism: [informative] Magma rises through cracks in the crust — but the eruption style depends on what's trapped inside. So what did she see in the field?
scene_lines.05_takeaway: [warmly] Volcanoes destroy — and they also build the land we walk on. The earth is never finished making itself.

geologist.name: Dr. Elena Reyes
geologist.voice_prompt: Enthusiastic field geologist, first-person expert, clear lip sync, accessible plain-language delivery
geologist.character_descriptor: woman, Latina geologist, 40s, field gear, documentary realism

voice_scripts.02_geologist_intro: I've stood on active vents where the ground was warm under my boots. You learn fast — pressure doesn't announce itself until it's too late to ignore.
voice_scripts.04_geologist_reply: When gas can't escape, the magma explodes outward. It's not anger — it's physics. And it's breathtaking when you're far enough away.

background_music.prompt: Documentary science score, sparse piano and low strings, 70 BPM, instrumental only, restrained wonder
